test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: There are 43 cadets in a battalion, and the commander is planning for an straight row arrangement of cadets on stage, facing north. P is 18th from the left side of the row and Q is 31st from the right side of the row. Find the number of cadets standing between P and Q.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Position of P from the left = 18th

Position of Q from the right = 31st

Total cadets in the row = 43

Position of Q from the left = Total cadets - Position of Q from the right + 1

= 43 - 31 + 1

= 13th

Number of cadets standing between P and Q = Position of P from the left - Position of Q from the left - 1

= 18 - 13 - 1

= 4

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
